title: Use Seedance 2.0 4K mode to generate a 15-second 4K parkour animation (expect…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 4K mode to generate a 15-second 4K parkour animation (expect ~20 credits/second on Seedance fast or ~18 credits/second on Seedance mini).  
Combine Midjourney V7 (for reference images) + GPT-2 (to draft a Chinese prompt) and feed two reference images (character + environment) into Seedance 2.0 4K.
